{{Quote|This Jedi is very powerful&mdash;or very dead!|Chieftain Gwarrk, commenting on Kit Fisto|<ref name="GoD" />}}
'''Gwarrk''' was a [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces [[Capture of Rishi|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] in order to get the planet's [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]]. After the Separatists successfully captured the [[Mining/Legends|mines]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] sent [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]], a [[Company/Legends|unit]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], to Rishi in order to retake them. Upon the arrival of the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], Gwarrk ordered Green Company's [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Rishi)|Clone Commander]] to [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)|start the battle]] despite the absence of a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]].

The Geonosians had the far better position and were able to repel the clones' attacks. After a short time, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] arrived and called for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to retreat. Although Gwarrk asked Fisto why he had recalled the clones and insisted on another attack, Fisto invented an alternative plan. He went to the entry of the mines and used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to deflect the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] shots of a [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]], [[Cooker|2242]], at the Geonosians. After Fisto had weakened the Geonosian defenses, the Republic forces&mdash;aided by Rishii warriors&mdash;were able to retake the mines.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Created this army for warfare, did you not? I put your warriors to their purpose. They failed because their power is not great enough.|Gwarrk, on the clone troopers|<ref name="GoD" />}}
A [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]], Gwarrk served as a [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] of his [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GoD" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces allied with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Capture of Rishi|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] and captured its [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] in order to obtain the exonium [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] needed to power their [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]]. To foil the Separatist plan and protect the planet's native inhabitants, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] dispatched [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]], a [[Company/Legends|unit]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], to retake the mines. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were ordered to not attack until a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] arrived, but Gwarrk assumed command of the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and commanded them to [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)|attack the mines]] anyway. The Geonosians, however, had prepared a well-entrenched defense, and the attack was beaten back.<ref name="GoD" />

[[File:Gwarrk_and_Fisto.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gwarrk compliments Kit Fisto.]]
Seeing the troopers pulling back, Gwarrk questioned who had given the order for a retreat, but his query was answered by the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], who had just arrived on Rishi. Fisto informed the chieftain that the troops were there to protect the Rishii from the Separatists and stated that no attack should have been made before his arrival. Gwarrk argued that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had created the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic Army]] for warfare, and he had simply put the clones to their purpose, adding that the troops had failed because their power had not been great enough. When Green Company's [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Rishi)|clone commander]] informed Fisto that the Geonosians had dug deep inside the canyon leading to the entrance of the mines, Gwarrk stated that his people needed the exonium to prepare their [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] in the frost [[Time/Legends|time]] and once again insisted on another attack. Fisto, however, formulated another plan and ordered the [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] to provide him with the company's best [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]].<ref name="GoD" />

Soon, without informing Gwarrk of his plans, Fisto went to the entrance of the mines. When Gwarrk asked the Clone [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] where the Jedi was, the latter told him that Fisto had apparently began an attack. Meanwhile, Fisto ordered the sharpshooter, [[Cooker|2242]] to aim at his shoulder and fire continuously. 2242 obliged, and Fisto started deflecting the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] shots at the Geonosians with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. As the Clone Commander rallied his forces and went to help Fisto, Gwarrk stated that the Jedi was either "very powerful or very [[Death/Legends|dead]]." By this time, however, all Geonosians in the canyon had been killed by Fisto's and 2242's combined efforts. The rest of the Republic forces&mdash;along with some of the Rishii warriors&mdash;then arrived and attacked the Geonosian troops inside the mines, forcing the remaining CIS forces to flee. Afterward, Gwarrk acknowledged that Fisto was very powerful, to which the Jedi replied that two factors had made this victory possible&mdash;the power of his mind and 2242's help.<ref name="GoD" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We need strength to give us victory!|Gwarrk, during the battle on Rishi|<ref name="GoD" />}}
Gwarrk was desperate to reclaim the exonium and ordered the clone troopers to attack without any chance of success. When the troops failed in their mission, he believed that the failure was due to the troopers' lack of strength, not because the enemy troops had a better position. Gwarrk did not care much about the clones, sending them to attack the Geonosians with low chances of succeeding and speaking to the commander with no respect, openly insulting him in front of Fisto. However, he greatly admired Fisto's skills and acknowledged them to him when the battle was over. Gwarrk had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and carried the [[Axe/Legends|axe]]-like [[Staff/Legends|staff]] weapon of a Rishii warrior. As a chieftain, he additionally wore a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] and a [[Crown/Legends|crown]]-like headdress.<ref name="GoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gwarrk first appeared in the [[2009]] [[Free Comic Book Day]]'s [[Star Wars comic books|comic]], [[The Gauntlet of Death|''The Clone Wars: The Gauntlet of Death'']], written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and illustrated by [[Ramón Pérez|Ramón K. Pérez]].<ref name="GoD" />
